description: This file defines the UserRoleManagerService class within the OrangeHRM system, responsible for managing user roles via dynamically loaded manager classes, and interacting with user and configuration data.

classes.name: UserRoleManagerService
classes.description: Service class that manages user role managers, dynamically loading and configuring role management objects based on system configuration.

methods.name: getUserRoleManagerClassName
methods.description: Retrieves the class name for the user role manager from system configuration.

methods.name: getUserRoleManager
methods.description: Instantiates and returns a user role manager object, configured with the current system user, with error handling for class existence and type.
